```python
from seedemu import Emulator, Layer, createInternetExchange, createAutonomousSystem, createNetwork, createRouter, createHost, createNode, WebService, bind

# Initialize emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
base_layer = Layer()
routing_layer = Layer()
service_layer = Layer()

# Create Internet Exchange
ix = createInternetExchange(100)
ix.setDisplayName("IX-100")
ix.setDescription("Internet Exchange with ID 100")
base_layer.addVertex(ix)

# Create three Autonomous Systems
as_ids = [200, 201, 202]
ases = []
for i, asn in enumerate(as_ids):
    # Create AS
    asys = createAutonomousSystem(asn)
    asys.setDisplayName(f"AS-{asn}")
    asys.setDescription(f"Autonomous System {asn}")
    base_layer.addVertex(asys)
    ases.append(asys)

    # Create two networks per AS
    net1 = createNetwork(f"net{asn}_1")
    net1.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn}-Net1")
    net1.setDescription(f"Network 1 in AS {asn}")
    base_layer.addVertex(net1)
    net2 = createNetwork(f"net{asn}_2")
    net2.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn}-Net2")
    net2.setDescription(f"Network 2 in AS {asn}")
    base_layer.addVertex(net2)

    # Create router joining both networks
    router = createRouter(f"r{asn}")
    router.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn}-Router")
    router.setDescription(f"Router in AS {asn} joining Net1 and Net2")
    base_layer.addVertex(router)
    router.joinNetwork(net1)
    router.joinNetwork(net2)

    # Create host joining net1
    host = createHost(f"h{asn}")
    host.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn}-Host")
    host.setDescription(f"Host in AS {asn} on Net1")
    base_layer.addVertex(host)
    host.joinNetwork(net1)

    # Create virtual node and install web service
    vnode = createNode(f"vweb{asn}")
    vnode.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn}-WebNode")
    vnode.setDescription(f"Virtual node for web service in AS {asn}")
    service_layer.addVertex(vnode)
    web_service = WebService()
    vnode.install(web_service)

    # Bind virtual node to host
    bind(vnode, host)

    # Add router and host to AS
    asys.addVertex(router)
    asys.addVertex(host)

# Peer all ASes with the Internet Exchange
for asys in ases:
    asys.joinInternetExchange(ix)

# Add layers to emulator
emu.addLayer(base_layer)
emu.addLayer(routing_layer)
emu.addLayer(service_layer)

# Render and compile with Docker, enabling internet map
emu.render()
emu.compile(Docker(), enableInternetMap=True)
```
